conviction_note: The bar here is the company's own FY2027/2 plan (revenue 862.78億 +6.0%, OP 43.0億 +9.2%, 経常 44.4億 +6.5%), and IFIS consensus for 経常 is 4,440百万 -- identical to guidance, i.e. nobody has independently marked it down on this thinly-covered name. Q1 (Feb21-May20) printed revenue +3% and OP -5% with personnel cost +8%, and because Q4 is a loss-making winter quarter H1 is structurally ~85-94% of full-year OP, so a soft H1 makes the +9.2% guide arithmetically strained rather than merely optimistic. I still size the reaction well below the sum of the findings for four reasons: all six months of H1 are already published as 月次 so the revenue line is pre-released; the shareholder base demonstrably looked through a 5.3% 経常 miss on 2026-04-03 and marked the stock to its year high that day because the VISION2028 plan came with it; the stock is already at PBR 0.81 with a 3.84% yield floored by a stated DOE 3% policy, so the de-rating is largely done; and the pure-play competitor DAIWA CYCLE (5888) posted record H1 sales and OP on 2026-09-14, which says the category through July was fine and caps the downside. Management's demonstrated habit is to hold guidance at H1 and cut in December, so the most likely single outcome is a soft H1 with the plan reaffirmed and a mild negative drift, not a cut.
bar: Company 会社予想 for FY2027/2 (ending 2027-02-20): 売上高 862.78億円 (+6.0%), 営業利益 43.0億円 (+9.2%), 経常利益 44.4億円 (+6.5%), 純利益 27.3億円 (+20.3%), set 2026-04-03 and reaffirmed at Q1 on 2026-06-22. IFIS consensus 経常 is 4,440百万 -- the same number. https://kabuyoho.ifis.co.jp/index.php?action=tp1&sa=consNewsDetail&nid=3333_20260403_act_20260403_130015_1 and https://www.nikkei.com/article/DGXZRST0575617S6A620C2000000/ . Sized against the H1 OP the guide implies at this name's historical H1 share of full-year OP (~88% of 43.0億 = ~37.8億); I expect roughly 33-35億.
positioning_check: JPX 空売り残高報告 register carries no disclosed short position at or above the 0.5% threshold for 3333 as of 2026-09-18 (sealed baseline, source https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html) -- a real zero, truncated at 0.5%, so there is no squeeze fuel behind a negative call and no crowded short to fade. 信用倍率 3.16 (margin longs 3.16x margin shorts, baseline, broker-portal scrape) is a mild retail long overhang rather than a short. There is no single-stock option market in Japan for this name, so there is no skew and no event-implied move; the only directional content in the baseline is run_up_20d_pct of -2.79%, which leans very slightly positive (priced_lean -0.11%).

findings.finding: The FY2027/2 company plan the whole market is anchored on (revenue 862.78億 +6.0%, OP 43.0億 +9.2%) requires roughly +7.5% revenue growth across the remaining nine months after a Q1 that grew 3%, at a time when the company has explicitly told investors it is suppressing new store openings under VISION2028 and its own published monthly existing-store series is running around flat -- and IFIS consensus 経常 for the year is 4,440百万, exactly the company number, so no analyst has marked the plan down.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance is the line that moves this stock, and it moves it hard when it is cut: the 2025-12-22 業績予想の修正 (revenue 858億 to 810億, OP 56.2億 to 42.3億) drove the shares down in the afternoon session and again the following day ('後場下げ幅を拡大', then '続落'), and the baseline's estimated December-2024 reaction is -6.42%. Reported-quarter surprises by contrast have been looked through: the FY2026/2 result on 2026-04-03 missed IFIS 経常 consensus by 5.3% and the stock set its 2026 high of 1,457 that day because the new mid-term plan landed with it. The estimated September reactions are small and mixed (-3.36, +1.87, +1.67).
findings.why_not_priced: If the market had marked the plan down, the sell-side 経常 number would not be byte-identical to the company's own 4,440百万 -- on a name with this little coverage the consensus is the company guide with the sign changed, and there is nothing else for a screen to read. It is also not in the tape as a directional bet: run_up_20d is only -2.79%, there is no disclosed short at the 0.5% threshold on the JPX register, and 信用倍率 3.16 says retail is long, not positioned for a disappointment. What would look different if this were priced: a visible gap between consensus and guidance, or a disclosed short balance, or a 20-day run-in materially worse than -3%.
findings.independence: The suppression of new openings and the DOE-3%/payout-35% return policy that the plan rests on come from a different document, the VISION2028 mid-term plan coverage at https://finance.logmi.jp/articles/384354 ; the Q1 revenue and cost figures come from Nikkei's 2026-06-22 report at https://www.nikkei.com/article/DGXZQOUF19A610Z10C26A6000000/ . Note this finding shares its underlying thesis with finding 2 below -- both say the FY plan is out of reach -- and they should be read as one direction, not two independent confirmations.

findings.finding: H1 operating profit is set to fall high-single to low-double digits year on year, because Q2 (May 21-Aug 20) is this company's thinnest-margin quarter -- prior-year Q2 standalone OP was only about 5.4億 on about 190億 of revenue, a ~2.8% margin, derived from H1 OP 37億 less Q1 OP ~31.6億 -- and Q1 already carried +8% personnel cost growth from wage rises and hiring plus new-store depreciation against revenue growth of just 3%, so a near-flat Q2 revenue line converts into a Q2 OP roughly half of last year's.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This stock has repeatedly not punished a weak reported half. The 2025-09 H1 print (revenue 459億 -1%, OP 37億 -21%, net 26億 -19%) sits on the estimated cadence as a +1.67% reaction, and the 2026-04-03 full-year print missed consensus 経常 by 5.3% and closed at the year's high. The reported quarter is not where this name's risk premium sits.
findings.why_not_priced: Honestly, most of this IS priced: the Q1 release is three months old and every month of H1 has been published as a 月次 by 2026-09-03, so any reader who wants the revenue line already has it. What is less well modelled on a one-analyst name is the operating leverage arithmetic -- that an 8% cost line growing against a 2.8%-margin quarter halves the quarter's profit -- and that is why this is sized at a fraction of finding 1 rather than beside it. If it were fully priced, the consensus 経常 would already sit below the company number, and it does not.
findings.independence: The Q1 cost and revenue detail is a separate Nikkei report, https://www.nikkei.com/article/DGXZQOUF19A610Z10C26A6000000/ (2026-06-22). Pointing the OTHER way, and recorded here rather than buried: direct competitor DAIWA CYCLE (5888) released H1 (Feb-Jul 2026) results and an August sales flash on 2026-09-14 reporting record half-year sales and operating profit (https://www.daiwa-cycle.co.jp/ir/library/presentation/), after a Q1 of revenue 69.6億 +12.3% and OP 6.56億 +7.3%, so the category through July was not weak and Asahi's problem is company-specific cost and share, not collapsing demand. That counterweight is why the high end of this range is positive.

outside_window.finding: The pattern that actually resizes this stock is a 業績予想の修正 filed in December, not at H1 -- the 2025-12-22 cut took revenue from 858億 to 810億 and OP from 56.2億 to 42.3億 and was sold hard. If the FY2027/2 plan is unreachable on the arithmetic above, the most likely date the market sees it confirmed is the Q3 print or a separate revision around late December 2026, months after this exit.

baseline_tension: It cuts mildly against the baseline: run_up_20d of -2.79% gives a slightly POSITIVE priced lean (-0.11% net) on the view that a name drifting down into a print has already discounted something, whereas what I found says the discount is not yet in the sell-side number at all -- but the stock's PBR of 0.81 and 3.84% DOE-floored yield say the equity market has already stopped believing the plan even while IFIS has not, which is the main reason my number is small.
lessons_applied: researcher_japan/LESSONS.md holds no rules yet -- it is deliberately empty pending a resolved Japanese run -- so nothing in it forced a change; what it does hold are three open questions, and question 2 ('Do monthly disclosures pre-empt the print? ... the honest size is smaller than it looks') applies literally here because all six months of H1 were published as 月次 by 2026-09-03.

On that basis I cut finding 2, the reported-quarter H1 operating-profit finding, from -1.0 to -0.5, because it rests almost entirely on data already in the public record (the 2026-06-22 Q1 release and the monthly series); impact_sum moved from -3.0 to -2.5.
Left finding 1 at -2.0: its unpriced component is that IFIS consensus 経常 equals the company guide exactly, which is not visible in any monthly and is not pre-empted by them.

Question 1 (進捗率 is the bar) confirmed the bar I had already chosen -- the company's own FY plan, not sell-side EPS -- so no change there. Question 3 (a prior 業績予想の修正 kills the event) does not bite: no revision has been filed for this fiscal year.
